translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Davidi mu thangu kaba mu dikanga di Yuda.

content.text: A Nzambi ! Ngeyo widi Nzambiꞌama,
mu kiedika ngeyo ndintomba ;
muelꞌama wulembo moni phuila yi ngeyo ;
nitu ama tsatu yidi mu kumona mu tsi yi yuma ;
yibiva ; yikondolo nlangu ;
Ndimmona mu buangu kinlongo
ndimona lulendo luaku ayi nkembo aku.
Bila luzolo luaku luviatukidi luzingu ;
bididi biama biela kukembisa.
Ndiela kuzitisa thangu yoso ndidi moyo.
Mu diambu di dizina diaku, ndiela vumuna mioko miama ku yilu.
Muelꞌama wela yukuta banga kimvuama kiwombo ki bidia
mu minkunga bididi bi munu ama biela kuzitisa.
Va mbukꞌama ndikutebukilanga moyo
ndieti kuyindula builu bu mvimba.
Bila ngeyo lusadusu luama,
ayi ndilembo yimbila ku tsi kitsusula ki mavavi maku.
Muelꞌama widi wukangama mu ngeyo ;
ayi koko kuaku kulubakala kueti kukhindisa.
Bobo beti tomba luzingu luama bela bungana ;
bela kota kuna tsi ntoto.
Bela kuba yekula mu lulendo lu sabala ;
bela kituka bidia bi zimbua zi nsitu.
Vayi Ntinu wela mona khini mu Nzambi ;
baboso bobo banleva ndefi mu dizina di Nzambi bela kunzitisa.
Bila miunu mi bankua luvunu miela kangama.
